_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); defense prime contractor signals

pit_profile.why: 'In 2006, 84% of our net sales were made to the U.S. Government, either as a prime contractor or as a subcontractor.' (FY2006 10-K, Item 1); 'Reduced funding for defense procurement and research and development programs could adversely affect our ability to grow or maintain our sales and profitability.' (Item 1A): sales that depend on Congressional appropriations are not earnings that are the cycle, so DURABLE (the CAT and SO precedent); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery taking share in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, and the 10-K names no offshore competition, so no disruption theme in scope is live

classification.quality_note: 'In 2006, 84% of our net sales were made to the U.S. Government, either as a prime contractor or as a subcontractor.' (FY2006 10-K, Item 1); 'Reduced funding for defense procurement and research and development programs could adversely affect our ability to grow or maintain our sales and profitability.' (Item 1A): sales that depend on Congressional appropriations are not earnings that are the cycle, so DURABLE (the CAT and SO precedent); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery taking share in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, and the 10-K names no offshore competition, so no disruption theme in scope is live. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.16x; +15% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.62; conservative 2yr +3%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY03-FY06, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.5%/yr (FY07 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 5.0-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +35.3%/yr (FY03-FY06 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +43.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY06); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LMT (retrospective, 2008-01-11) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.16x (18.7% downside to Bear $89 / +116.5% upside to Bull $237) | Adj composite 2.69 vs market 2.07: gap +0.62 [UNDERVALUED] | +15% above the EPP floor $95 (14x FY07E $6.78) | Conservative 2-yr case: +2.6% total (+1.3%/yr) | At 16.2x FY07E the 15% hurdle price $145 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; backlog -6.7% in Q3 2007, forward revenues +3.5-5.4% (FY07 net sales guide); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, and the 10-Ks name no offshore competition; no theme in scope has dated evidence.
